open_items: Target 19.k.W requires its own successful Apply gate and commit.

Real per-ABI runtime evidence for CPython 3.10–3.13 is not available in this preparation. No all-ABI or ARM compatibility is asserted; missing proofs remain release blockers under M19 final gate, 19.y and 20.k.
Real classifier integration, model loading, scoring and resource evidence remain in 19.m–19.y; package import and worker transport are not language detection or approval.

oracle.requirement_contract: Der ausgelieferte Adapter MUSS py3langid 0.4.0 und das ausdrücklich gebundene mitgelieferte Modell als Referenzbackend nach Anhang T.6 verwenden.
oracle.scope: Exact complete offline file inventory, pinned original wheels/model/licenses, optional dependency separation, unchanged Core module/zipapp identity and explicit incompatible/missing ABI errors.

preconditions: Exact original offline wheels and an explicit independently trusted Core build.
Stage behavior is executed only in its Apply gate; pure collection is not acceptance.
steps: Build a separate offline add-on with exact wheel, model and license hashes; reject unavailable or changed inputs.
